messages.content: Selamat pagi. Saya Dr Tan, IoT research lead di MIMOS Cyberjaya. Saya nak setup experiment untuk benchmark LoRaWAN range di kawasan urban Klang Valley. Boleh start dengan create new experiment project?
Selamat pagi Encik Dr Tan, terima kasih kerana menghubungi LPWAN Experiment Platform. Saya akan cipta projek eksperimen baru untuk Encik. Mohon tunggu sebentar.

function.name: create_experiment_project
function.arguments: {"project_name": "LoRaWAN Urban Klang Valley Range Benchmark 2026", "project_owner": "dr.tan.mimos", "organization_id": "org-mimos-cyberjaya", "description": "Benchmark LoRaWAN SF7-12 range and link budget across urban Klang Valley scenarios", "tags": ["lorawan", "urban", "klang_valley", "benchmark"], "start_date": "2026-05-22", "target_end_date": "2026-07-15"}

messages.name: create_experiment_project
messages.content: {"project_id": "prj-lpwan-1129", "project_name": "LoRaWAN Urban Klang Valley Range Benchmark 2026", "status": "draft", "created_at": "2026-05-21T09:00:00+08:00", "workspace_url": "https://lpwan.mimos.my/prj-lpwan-1129"}

Projek dicipta: **`prj-lpwan-1129`**, status draft, workspace tersedia di Mimos LPWAN portal.

Mahu saya tetapkan hipotesis dan rancangan eksperimen untuk projek ini?
Yes, define hypothesis. Saya nak test sama ada SF11/SF12 boleh achieve >5km range di urban dense, dengan PER <5%. Pastu plan experiment untuk 3 lokasi: KLCC, Mid Valley, PJ Section 13.
Baik Encik. Saya tetapkan hipotesis dan rancangan eksperimen serentak.

function.name: define_hypothesis
function.arguments: {"project_id": "prj-lpwan-1129", "hypothesis_statement": "SF11 and SF12 LoRaWAN configurations can achieve >5km range in dense urban environments with packet error rate below 5%", "null_hypothesis": "SF11 and SF12 cannot reliably exceed 5km range with PER<5% in dense urban environments", "success_criteria": [{"metric": "range_km", "comparator": ">=", "threshold": 5.0}, {"metric": "packet_error_rate", "comparator": "<=", "threshold": 0.05}], "variables": {"independent": ["spreading_factor", "location_density"], "dependent": ["rssi", "snr", "packet_error_rate", "range_km"]}}

messages.name: define_hypothesis
messages.content: {"hypothesis_id": "hyp-lpwan-001", "project_id": "prj-lpwan-1129", "status": "defined", "created_at": "2026-05-21T09:02:11+08:00"}

messages.name: plan_lpwan_experiment
messages.content: {"plan_id": "plan-lpwan-001", "project_id": "prj-lpwan-1129", "total_runs": 9, "estimated_duration_hours": 54, "testbed_requirements": {"gateways": 3, "end_devices": 9, "spectrum_band": "AS923-1"}, "created_at": "2026-05-21T09:02:12+08:00"}

Hipotesis (`hyp-lpwan-001`) dan rancangan (`plan-lpwan-001`) dicipta:

- 9 test run (3 lokasi × 3 SF config)
- Anggaran 54 jam keseluruhan
- Testbed: 3 gateway, 9 end device, band AS923-1

Mahu saya semak ketersediaan testbed dan tempah slot?
Yes, semak availability untuk minggu depan, dan kalau available terus reserve untuk hari Isnin sampai Rabu.
Baik Encik. Saya semak ketersediaan testbed dan tempah slot serentak.

messages.name: check_testbed_availability
messages.content: {"available": true, "available_slots": [{"start": "2026-05-25T09:00:00+08:00", "end": "2026-05-27T18:00:00+08:00", "all_resources_available": true}], "conflicts": []}

messages.name: reserve_testbed_slot
messages.content: {"reservation_id": "res-tb-9931", "plan_id": "plan-lpwan-001", "start": "2026-05-25T09:00:00+08:00", "end": "2026-05-27T18:00:00+08:00", "status": "reserved", "resources_locked": {"gateways": 3, "end_devices": 9}}

Tempahan disahkan:

- **Reservation:** `res-tb-9931` — 25-27 Mei (Isnin-Rabu)
- Semua sumber telah dikunci

Mahu saya konfigurasi peranti dan firmware untuk eksperimen?
Yes please configure devices. Use latest firmware `lora-fw-v3.4.1`. Pastu sebelum run, simulate dulu untuk pastikan no issues.
Baik Encik. Saya konfigurasi peranti dan simulate pelaksanaan serentak.

messages.name: configure_devices_and_firmware
messages.content: {"configuration_id": "cfg-lpwan-001", "plan_id": "plan-lpwan-001", "firmware_version": "lora-fw-v3.4.1", "devices_configured": 9, "calibration_status": "passed", "baseline_metrics": {"avg_tx_freq_error_hz": 12, "avg_rx_sensitivity_dbm": -137}, "configured_at": "2026-05-21T09:08:00+08:00"}

messages.name: simulate_project_execution
messages.content: {"simulation_id": "sim-lpwan-001", "plan_id": "plan-lpwan-001", "verdict": "pass_with_warnings", "warnings": ["SF12 transmit duty cycle may approach AS923-1 1% limit at planned packet rate; recommend spacing 10s minimum"], "projected_duration_hours": 51.5, "resource_check": "ok"}

Hasil:

- **Konfigurasi:** `cfg-lpwan-001` — 9 peranti dengan firmware v3.4.1, calibration passed (sensitivity -137 dBm)
- **Simulasi:** `sim-lpwan-001` → pass dengan amaran:
  - SF12 duty cycle hampir capai 1% AS923-1 — disyorkan 10s spacing

Saya cadangkan tambah spacing 10s untuk SF12. Boleh saya teruskan, atau kena dapatkan kelulusan dahulu sebab projek ini menggunakan testbed berkongsi?
Bagus catch. Yes submit untuk approval — head IoT lab Encik Lim kena lulus. Hantar bersama hasil simulasi untuk reference.
Baik Encik. Saya kemukakan untuk kelulusan.

function.name: submit_project_for_approval
function.arguments: {"project_id": "prj-lpwan-1129", "plan_id": "plan-lpwan-001", "approver_ids": ["lim.weiming"], "approver_roles": ["iot_lab_head"], "justification": "LoRaWAN urban range benchmark using shared testbed 25-27 May. Configurations validated (cfg-lpwan-001), simulation sim-lpwan-001 passed with one warning (SF12 spacing). Will apply 10s spacing for SF12 runs.", "attachments": ["sim-lpwan-001", "cfg-lpwan-001"]}

messages.name: submit_project_for_approval
messages.content: {"approval_id": "apr-prj-7711", "project_id": "prj-lpwan-1129", "status": "pending", "approvers": [{"approver_id": "lim.weiming", "role": "iot_lab_head", "notified_at": "2026-05-21T09:10:00+08:00"}], "sla_due": "2026-05-22T09:10:00+08:00"}

Permohonan kelulusan dihantar: **`apr-prj-7711`** — pending dari Encik Lim, SLA 24 jam.

Apa lagi Encik mahu sediakan sementara menunggu?
Encik Lim baru e-mel dia approve. Record decision dia, dan start run untuk KLCC location dulu (SF7 dahulu, lepas tu naik ke SF11 dan SF12).
Baik Encik. Saya rekod kelulusan dan mulakan eksperimen untuk lokasi KLCC.

function.name: record_project_approval_decision
function.arguments: {"approval_id": "apr-prj-7711", "decision": "approved", "decided_by": "lim.weiming", "decision_notes": "Approved via email. Confirm SF12 spacing in place.", "decided_at": "2026-05-21T09:14:00+08:00"}

messages.name: record_project_approval_decision
messages.content: {"approval_id": "apr-prj-7711", "final_status": "approved", "recorded_at": "2026-05-21T09:14:01+08:00"}

messages.name: start_experiment_run
messages.content: {"run_id": "run-lpwan-klcc-001", "plan_id": "plan-lpwan-001", "location": "KLCC", "status": "running", "current_phase": "SF7", "started_at": "2026-05-21T09:14:30+08:00", "expected_completion": "2026-05-21T15:14:30+08:00"}

Eksperimen telah bermula:

- Kelulusan Encik Lim direkod
- **Run:** `run-lpwan-klcc-001` — KLCC, fasa SF7
- Jangka selesai: 3:14 petang

Mahu saya semak status sekarang, atau kita tunggu fasa SF7 selesai?
Check status. Saya nak pastikan packet logging berjalan ok untuk SF7.
Baik Encik. Saya semak status run sekarang.

messages.name: get_experiment_run_status
messages.content: {"run_id": "run-lpwan-klcc-001", "status": "running", "current_phase": "SF7", "progress_pct": 18, "realtime_metrics": {"packets_sent": 220, "packets_received": 215, "per": 0.0227, "avg_rssi_dbm": -78, "avg_snr_db": 8.5}, "packet_log_health": "healthy", "telemetry_lag_seconds": 1.2}

Status:

- SF7 progress 18% — 220 dihantar, 215 diterima
- PER: **2.27%** (di bawah threshold 5%)
- RSSI purata: -78 dBm, SNR: 8.5 dB
- Packet logging: **healthy**, lag 1.2s

Semua data mengalir dengan baik. Adakah ada apa-apa lagi yang Encik mahu saya pantau?
Bagus. Sambil tunggu, boleh attach evidence — protocol document `evd-protocol-v2` untuk projek ni, supaya semua dalam satu tempat untuk paper kami nanti. Pastu add comment yang KLCC run start ok.
Sudah tentu, Encik. Saya lampirkan protokol dan tambah komen serentak.

function.name: add_project_comment
function.arguments: {"project_id": "prj-lpwan-1129", "comment": "KLCC SF7 run started at 09:14 — PER 2.27% within target, telemetry healthy. Will proceed to SF11/SF12 phases sequentially.", "visibility": "team", "author": "dr.tan.mimos"}

messages.name: attach_project_evidence
messages.content: {"project_id": "prj-lpwan-1129", "attached": 1, "evidence_ids": ["evd-prj-1129-proto"], "attached_at": "2026-05-21T09:18:00+08:00"}

messages.name: add_project_comment
messages.content: {"comment_id": "cmt-prj-1129-001", "project_id": "prj-lpwan-1129", "created_at": "2026-05-21T09:18:00+08:00", "author": "dr.tan.mimos"}

Selesai:

- Protokol dilampir: `evd-prj-1129-proto`
- Komen ditambah: `cmt-prj-1129-001`

Masih ada apa-apa lagi, Encik?
One more thing — boleh launch analysis job untuk auto-process data dari run KLCC. Saya nak average RSSI per SF, PER trends, dan correlation dengan distance dari gateway.
Sudah tentu, Encik. Saya akan launch kerja analisa.

messages.name: launch_analysis_job
messages.content: {"analysis_job_id": "aj-lpwan-001", "project_id": "prj-lpwan-1129", "status": "queued", "queued_at": "2026-05-21T09:20:00+08:00", "estimated_first_results": "2026-05-21T15:30:00+08:00"}

Kerja analisa **`aj-lpwan-001`** telah dijadualkan — keputusan pertama dijangka pada 3:30 petang selepas KLCC selesai.

Adakah ada apa-apa lagi yang saya boleh bantu, Encik?
Last thing, boleh create rollback plan kalau test ada masalah midway — saya nak ada strategy untuk safely abort dan release testbed. Pastu kita wrap.
Sangat baik, Encik. Saya cipta pelan rollback dan langkah pelepasan testbed.

messages.name: create_rollback_plan
messages.content: {"rollback_plan_id": "rbp-lpwan-001", "project_id": "prj-lpwan-1129", "status": "armed", "created_at": "2026-05-21T09:22:00+08:00", "triggers_count": 3, "steps_count": 4}

Pelan rollback **`rbp-lpwan-001`** telah diarm — 3 triggers, 4 steps. Sistem akan secara automatik abort jika triggers dipenuhi.

Ringkasan akhir sesi:
1. Projek `prj-lpwan-1129` + hipotesis + rancangan 9-run
2. Testbed `res-tb-9931` (25-27 Mei)
3. Konfigurasi + simulasi + kelulusan
4. KLCC SF7 berjalan (PER 2.27%)
5. Protokol & komen dilampirkan
6. Kerja analisa `aj-lpwan-001` dijadualkan
7. Pelan rollback `rbp-lpwan-001` diarm

Terima kasih kerana menghubungi LPWAN Experiment Platform, Encik. Selamat menjalankan eksperimen.
